command:
ls -la /sys/bus/i2c/devices/2-0041/; printf '
DT PROPERTIES
'; ls -l /sys/bus/i2c/devices/2-0041/of_node/; for f in compatible status; do p=/sys/bus/i2c/devices/2-0041/of_node/$f; if [ -r "$p" ]; then printf '%s: ' "$f"; tr '\000' '
' < "$p"; fi; done; printf '
MODULE
'; modinfo lt9611uxd 2>&1 | head -n 25; printf '
KERNEL LOG SIZE
'; dmesg | wc -c; printf '
KERNEL JOURNAL
'; journalctl -b -k --no-pager | grep -Ei 'lt9611|hdmi|hpd|edid|dsi' | tail -n 90
